## Counts

- **Cupertino** (City of Cupertino and Recology South Bay, its contracted hauler): Compost 14, Landfill 17, Recycling 20, Special handling 10, unknown 17
- **San José** (City of San José Environmental Services Department (SanJoseRecycles.org)): Garbage 39, Recycling 24, Special handling 12, Yard trimmings 2, unknown 1
- **Palo Alto** (City of Palo Alto and GreenWaste of Palo Alto, its contracted hauler. Single-family carts are blue recycling, green compost, and black garbage.): Compost 15, Garbage 22, Recycling 22, Special handling 7, unknown 12
- **Los Altos** (City of Los Altos and Mission Trail Waste Systems, its contracted hauler. The residential guide's carts are blue recycling, green organics, and gray garbage.): Compost 13, Landfill 19, Recycling 19, Special handling 8, unknown 19
- **Berkeley** (City of Berkeley household sorting guide. Each household has a blue recycling bin, a green compost bin, and a grey trash bin. For 1-9 unit buildings the Ecology Center supplies the recycling carts. The city's dark-blue recycling cart is for 10 or more units and is not used here.): Compost 5, Landfill 14, Recycling 13, Special handling 4, unknown 42
